integrity.statement_supported_by: Algebraic proof of all-parameter Jordan decomposition and finite-field temporal-count formulas; independently structured finite scripts are corroboration only.
integrity.unproved_scope: No assertion of broader grid classification or of historical uniqueness.

scientific_limitations: Only odd prime characteristic, side length p^r-1, and open square grid; no claim for arbitrary side lengths or other boundary conditions.
The modular Jordan-sum and Lefschetz methods are prior art. Two plausibly relevant older articles were not inspected in full; historical priority cannot be certified.
title: Complete temporal census of odd-prime-power open-square automata
